1.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to the respondents not to disburse the
compensation amount to any of the parties till disposal of Appeal No.40 of 2020 (Firey vs. Jamshed
Ali and others) said to be pending between the petitioner and the private respondents in relation to
title over the acquired land.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for respondent No.4 points out that the compensation amount is in deposit with the Competent Authority and the application filed by the petitioner before respondent No.4 is misconceived.

4. On query made by the Court as to whether the petitioner has sought any reference of the dispute relating to apportionment as provided under Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, counsel for the petitioner is not in a position to give any specific reply.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5. We dispose of the instant petition with liberty to the petitioner, if so advised, to seek reference of the dispute in relation to apportionment of compensation amount between the parties by moving appropriate application before the Collector so that further action in the matter is taken in accordance with law.
6. The order has been passed in the presence of Shri Pranjal Mehrotra, counsel for the respondents.
